Hiring Team
Plenti
Re: Senior Product Manager, Strategic Origination Platforms

Dear Hiring Team at Plenti,

My background as a Business Analyst/Project Manager/Scrum Master is a direct match for the Senior Product Manager, Strategic Origination Platforms role at Plenti. At ANZ, I defined the technical vision and owned the product backlog for a cloud-native core banking platform modernisation that cut delivery time by over 30% while ensuring 100% compliance with enterprise risk models — a direct parallel to the platform ownership and regulatory-embedding focus of this role.

The role requires driving platform architecture decisions with engineering and translating operational pain points into product improvements. At ANZ, I led the transition of core banking platforms to cloud-native .NET/Azure, reducing end-to-end delivery time by over 30% and infrastructure costs by over 15%. At the ATO, I architected a COBOL/mainframe test-evidence automation that cut evidence effort from ~3 hours to ~15 minutes per scenario — a 92% reduction across 200+ SIT/E2E scenarios — by building a zero-new-approvals toolchain with REXX, SMF, SDSF, and PowerShell. This directly addressed an operational bottleneck that threatened the SIT window. Embedding regulatory requirements into product design is another core ask: at NAB, I managed delivery for a risk and compliance program that ensured 100% regulatory adherence for major data initiatives, and I translated complex regulatory requirements into actionable technical specifications. The cross-functional stakeholder alignment you need mirrors my work convening a technical war room at the ATO that produced a binding automation recommendation in under three hours, and facilitating workshops for 40+ GMs and executives at ANZ to align on strategy, which improved decision-making efficiency by over 55%.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my experience owning platform roadmaps, embedding compliance into technical delivery, and systematically removing operational friction through automation could support Plenti’s origination platform goals. I am available for a call or interview at your convenience.

Sincerely,
GAP-P7-DEF-B Probe 1785452243543
